en-US.title: Misbaha مِسْبَحَة
en-US.subtitle: By Zikr Apps
en-US.promoText: Search duas, build custom goals, and hold to complete targets — your daily dhikr companion from Zikr Apps.
en-US.releaseNotes:
• Search duas by transliteration or Arabic on Tasbeeh and Goals
• Plan a custom goal: name it, pick duas, remove days, and search to fill blanks
• Progress bar toward daily targets; hold 3 seconds to complete the rest
• Theme carousel in Settings
• Updated onboarding tutorial
en-US.description:
Misbaha is a tasbeeh and adhkar counter from Zikr Apps — calm, private, and built for daily dhikr.

• Count duas with tap, double-tap, or long-press
• Morning, night, and Quranic adhkar
• Goals, badges, and a goal library to plan dhikr
• Insights with garden, earth, and space visualizations
• Themes, English and Urdu with RTL support
• All counts stay on your device

Published by Zikr Apps.
Contact: salam@zikrapps.com

review.notes: Misbaha is an offline dhikr counter. No login is required. All user data stays on device.
